PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/向量 Vectors：标量与矢量: A vector has both magnitude and direction; a scalar has magnitude only. Add vectors with the tip-to-tail triangle method or the parallelogram method from a common origin, or resolve them into perpendicular components and add by direction. Common errors are adding vector magnitudes as if they were scalars and forgetting to state the final direction angle.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/向量应用：相对速度、速度变化量、: Relative velocity uses vector addition, v(A relative to ground)=v(A relative to B)+v(B relative to ground). Change in velocity Δv is the vector difference of final minus initial velocity, and its direction is not necessarily the same as the initial velocity. The force table experiment pulls a ring to equilibrium with three forces to verify vector addition; keep one consistent scale when drawing.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/力与斜面：牛顿三大定律、惯性、受: Newton’s three laws are the law of inertia, F=ma, and the action–reaction law. Inertia depends only on mass, not on speed. In a free body diagram draw only the forces acting on that object, and the normal force N is perpendicular to the contact surface; its magnitude follows from equilibrium and is not necessarily equal to mg.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/斜面分量：W∥ = mg sin: Resolve weight into components along and perpendicular to the incline: the component down the slope is mg sinθ and the perpendicular component is mg cosθ, so on a smooth incline N=mg cosθ. On a rough surface friction is f=μN, opposing motion when sliding, while static friction varies with the applied force until it reaches its maximum.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/运动方程：s = ut + ½a: For uniformly accelerated straight-line motion the three equations relate velocity to time, displacement to time, and velocity to displacement: s=ut+½at², v=u+at, v²=u²+2as. Statics deals with zero net force and dynamics with non-zero net force; apparent weight in a lift is the normal force, not the weight.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/功与能：W = Fs = mgΔ: Work is defined as force times displacement along the direction of the force, W=Fs, so the work done by gravity equals mgΔh. Gravitational potential energy PE=mgΔh and kinetic energy KE=½mv² are both measured in joules. Only the component of force along the displacement does work; a force perpendicular to the displacement does zero work, the most common place to lose marks.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/能量守恒与转化（PE↔KE→热）: Mechanical energy converts between forms and the total is conserved as long as no non-conservative force does work; always define the zero potential energy level before writing the equation. Non-conservative forces such as friction convert mechanical energy into internal energy, so energy is still conserved but mechanical energy decreases. In a spring oscillator elastic potential energy and kinetic energy swap back and forth, each reaching a maximum twice per period.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/动量：p = mv、冲量 I =: Momentum p=mv is a vector in the same direction as velocity; impulse equals the change in momentum, I=FΔt=Δp, which explains why cushioning reduces the impact force. Total momentum is conserved when the net external force on the system is zero. A common error is dropping the sign of a velocity in the conservation equation, so momenta in opposite directions get added instead of subtracted.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/碰撞类型：弹性（KE 守恒）、非: An elastic collision conserves both momentum and kinetic energy; an inelastic collision conserves only momentum, with some kinetic energy becoming heat and deformation; in a perfectly inelastic collision the two objects stick together and move as one. An explosion is a zero-momentum system splitting in opposite directions. To classify a collision, first check whether kinetic energy is conserved, then set up the equations.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/直线运动：平均速度/加速度、匀加: Average velocity equals total displacement divided by total time, not the arithmetic mean of the speeds of each stage. Acceleration is the rate of change of velocity, and an object slows down when acceleration is opposite to velocity. Free fall is uniformly accelerated motion starting from rest with a=g=9.80 m·s⁻² directed downwards.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/位移-时间图（斜率=速度）与速度: Keep the two graph types distinct: on a displacement–time graph the gradient is velocity, while on a velocity–time graph the gradient is acceleration and the area between the line and the time axis is displacement. The direction of curvature shows the sign of the acceleration; to find the gradient at a point you must draw a tangent, not a chord, and this is where marks are most often lost in graph questions.
PHY 物理/前置知识（Year 11 复习）/竖直抛体、反应时间与刹车距离: Vertical projection is acted on by gravity alone, and the upward and downward stages are symmetric; at the highest point the velocity is zero but the acceleration is still g. The whole motion is handled with v=u+at and s=ut+½at², taking upwards as positive so a=−g. Total stopping distance is the distance travelled at constant speed during the reaction time plus the braking distance, so reaction time cannot be ignored.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/实验报告结构：Title / Aim /: A proper report must contain title, aim, theory and hypothesis, apparatus and diagram, method, results, discussion and conclusion. The method is the only basis on which someone else can reproduce the experiment, so write it in the past tense and passive voice with equipment specifications and the quantities measured. The conclusion may only answer the question posed in the aim and must not introduce new data.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/变量：自变量/因变量/控制变量；定性（名: The independent variable is what the experimenter deliberately changes, the dependent variable is the response being measured, and everything else that must be held constant is a controlled variable. Quantitative data is either discrete (countable) or continuous (measurable), while qualitative data is nominal or ordinal. Common errors are listing a controlled variable as the dependent variable, or failing to say exactly how it was kept constant.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/有效数字规则；加减法按小数位、乘除法按最: Significant figures record measurement precision: for addition and subtraction keep the least number of decimal places, and for multiplication and division keep the least number of significant figures. Final answers in this subject are written to 3 significant figures, while intermediate steps should carry one extra digit to avoid accumulating rounding error. Scientific notation avoids ambiguity such as 0.00.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/绝对不确定度（±1 最小分度、与均值的最: The absolute uncertainty of a single reading on an analogue instrument is often taken as half the smallest division or one division, while for repeated measurements it is the maximum deviation or the mean absolute deviation. Relative (percentage) uncertainty equals the absolute uncertainty divided by the measured value, times 100%. Percentage uncertainty is usually found first because it is the form that can be compared and combined.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/不确定度合成：加减法直接相加、乘除法先转: The rule for combining uncertainties depends on the operation: for addition and subtraction add the absolute uncertainties directly, while for multiplication, division or powers convert each to a percentage first and then add. A constant coefficient carries no uncertainty, and for a power multiply the percentage by the exponent. On a graph an error bar is drawn as a vertical line segment through the point showing the uncertainty range.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/作图规范：轴标签含单位、分度用 2/4/: Plot the independent variable on the horizontal axis and the dependent variable on the vertical axis, and label each axis as quantity / unit. Choose a scale in multiples of 2, 4 or 5 so values are easy to read, and let the line fill about three-quarters of the page. The line of best fit should pass evenly through the points; do not force it through the origin unless theory requires it.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/由最佳拟合线求梯度（画 gradient: Find the gradient by taking two points on the line of best fit and drawing a gradient triangle, choosing points as far apart as possible to reduce reading error rather than using the original data points. Give the gradient to 2 significant figures with its unit. If the graph is curved, linearise it first before finding the gradient, or take the gradient of the tangent at a point.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/线性化 linearisation：y: Linearisation means rearranging a non-linear relationship into the form y=mx+c so the graph is a straight line, for example plotting T² against l or 1/v against 1/u. The gradient and intercept each correspond to some combination of physical quantities, so dimensional analysis is needed first to confirm their units. This is the standard method for experimental questions that ask you to determine a constant.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/误差类型：系统误差（未校准、方法缺陷）v: A systematic error has a fixed cause that shifts every reading in the same direction, such as an uncalibrated instrument, an incorrect zero or a flawed method; repeated measurement cannot remove it, so it must be fixed by calibration or an improved method. A random error has unpredictable causes and scatters readings about the true value, and it is reduced by taking many measurements and averaging.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/效度 validity / 信度 rel: Validity asks whether the experiment really measured the intended physical quantity; reliability asks whether repeated measurements give consistent results; accuracy is how close a measured value is to the true value; and precision is how close repeated measurements are to one another. The four are independent: a set of measurements can be very precise yet very inaccurate because of systematic error.
PHY 物理/U3 · 实验理论与技能/误差削减方法与讨论：对比理论值、% er: The discussion should compare results with theoretical or literature values, calculate a percentage error or percentage difference and analyse where it came from. An outlier may be discarded only when there is a clear reason, such as a handling mistake or unstable equipment; otherwise keep it and include it in the discussion. Deleting data simply because a value deviates greatly is a classic mistake.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/抛体定义与抛物线轨迹；水平与竖直分量相互独立: Projectile motion is two-dimensional motion under gravity alone, with a parabolic path. It can be treated in components because the horizontal and vertical directions do not affect each other, so they can be analysed separately on the same time axis. The deflection of a charged particle in a uniform electric field has the same mathematics and is called projectile-like motion.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/水平方向：a = 0，ux = vx = 常数: There is no force horizontally, so the acceleration is zero and the horizontal component of velocity is constant throughout; the range equals the horizontal velocity times the time of flight, R=uxT. The key point is that the time of flight T is determined entirely by the vertical motion and is independent of the horizontal velocity, so it cannot be treated as a known quantity and substituted directly.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/竖直方向：a = −g，最高点时竖直速度 v_: Vertically only gravity acts, so the acceleration is constantly −g (taking upwards as positive). At the highest point the vertical component of velocity is zero but the horizontal component is not, so the velocity at the top is not zero. At the same height the upward and downward speeds are equal, a symmetry that gives a quick check on whether an answer is reasonable.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/速度矢量分解：ux = u cosθ、uy =: Resolve the initial velocity into a horizontal component u cosθ and a vertical component u sinθ, with θ measured from the horizontal. This resolution is the first step; afterwards the two directions are calculated independently. Common errors are taking the angle from the vertical, or substituting the resultant velocity straight into the vertical equation of motion.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/解题步骤：画图→分解→x/y 独立分析→三运动: The standard procedure is to draw a diagram and mark the known quantities, resolve the initial velocity, then apply the equations of motion separately in the horizontal and vertical directions, and finally combine the velocity components with Pythagoras and find the direction angle with tanθ. When asked for a velocity you must give both magnitude and direction; a bare number loses marks.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/互余角射出同射程（15°/75°）；45° 射: For the same initial speed from the same level, two complementary launch angles (such as 15° and 75°) give the same range, and 45° gives the maximum range, because sin2θ takes the same value for a pair of complementary angles. Of a complementary pair the larger angle reaches a greater height and stays in the air longer, but the horizontal range is the same.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/空气阻力的影响：减小射程与最大高度、增大下落角: Air resistance makes both the actual range and the maximum height smaller than the ideal parabola, makes the path asymmetric with a steeper descent, and slightly reduces the optimum launch angle below 45°. How much it matters depends on the frontal cross-sectional area, the mass and the speed. If a question asks about the difference between real and theoretical values, explain it in terms of energy loss and the direction of the drag force.
PHY 物理/U3 · 抛体运动/抛体运动中的能量守恒；应用题型（投弹、射箭、踢: With air resistance ignored, the mechanical energy of a projectile is conserved, so ½mu²=mgh+½mv² gives the speed directly from the height without needing the time. Vertically it obeys v²=u_y²−2gΔh. Finding an impact speed by energy is usually quicker and less error-prone than calculating the time first and then combining components.
PHY 物理/U3 · 圆周运动/匀速圆周运动（水平面）: Uniform circular motion means the speed is constant but the direction of velocity changes at every instant, so the object is always accelerating and the motion is non-uniform velocity. The period T and frequency f are reciprocals, and angular velocity is written ω=2π/T=2πf. A common error is to think that because the speed is constant the acceleration and net force must be zero.
PHY 物理/U3 · 圆周运动/向心力与向心加速度：F_c = mv²/r =: Centripetal acceleration points towards the centre with magnitude a_c=v²/r=ω²r; by Newton’s second law the net force producing it is the centripetal force F_c=mv²/r=mω²r. Centripetal force is a net effect, not a separate force, so it must never be drawn as an extra arrow on a free body diagram, the most typical mistake in this topic.
PHY 物理/U3 · 圆周运动/倾斜弯道 banked track 与飞机转弯: On a banked track the horizontal component of the normal force together with gravity supplies the centripetal force, and the ideal (frictionless) speed satisfies tanθ=v²/(rg), that is v=√(rg tanθ). When an aircraft turns, the horizontal component of the lift force acts as the centripetal force; the aircraft is banked to obtain that horizontal component rather than to maintain lift.
PHY 物理/U3 · 圆周运动/竖直圆周运动（匀速与非匀速）；摩天轮顶点/底点: In vertical circular motion the speed usually changes, and the tension together with the radial component of gravity supplies the centripetal force: at the lowest point T=mv²/r+mg and at the highest point T=mv²/r−mg, so the tension is greatest at the lowest point. On a Ferris wheel the apparent weight at the top is N=mg−mv²/r, less than mg, and greater than mg at the bottom.
PHY 物理/U3 · 圆周运动/圆周运动中的能量守恒: When an object rises or falls along a curved track gravity does work and the speed changes, so you must first use conservation of energy to find the speed at that point and then apply Newton’s second law radially at that point. Both steps are needed: the centripetal force equation alone has no solution while the speed is unknown. The critical condition at the top is that N or T is just zero, which gives v=√(gr).
PHY 物理/U3 · 圆周运动/实验：锥形摆测向心力（图像法）: In a conical pendulum the resultant of the tension and the weight supplies the centripetal force, giving F=mω²r, so a graph of F against ω² should be a straight line with gradient mr and zero intercept. The graphical method is used instead of a single-point calculation in order to average out random error and test whether the proportional relationship really holds, and the gradient can be used to recover the mass.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/万有引力定律 F = GmM/r²；力的: Any two point masses attract each other with force F=GmM/r² directed along the line joining them, and the pair forms an action–reaction pair, so the forces on the two bodies must be equal in magnitude. In calculations r is measured from the centre of the sphere, so for a satellite in low orbit r is the Earth’s radius and not the altitude; forgetting to add the radius is a common error.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/重力场 g-field 与场线：指向质心: The gravitational field is described by field lines: they always point from infinity towards the centre of mass (into the body), the field is stronger where the lines are closer together, and no two field lines can cross, because then the field direction at that point would not be unique. Outside a uniform spherical shell the field is the same as that of a point mass with all the mass at the centre, a common result to be quoted.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/重力场强度 g = F/m = GM/r: Gravitational field strength is defined as the force per unit mass, g=F/m=GM/r², with the unit N/kg equivalent to m·s⁻². The value of g at the surface varies slightly with latitude: it is smallest at the equator because the radius is larger and part of the gravitational pull provides the rotation, and it decreases with altitude or down a mine shaft.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/常数：G = 6.67×10⁻¹¹、M_: These constants must be taken from the formula and data sheet before calculating: gravitational constant G=6.67×10⁻¹¹ N·m²·kg⁻², mass of the Earth 5.97×10²⁴ kg, radius of the Earth 6.37×10⁶ m, and mean Earth–Moon distance 3.84×10⁸ m. When using R_E note that the data sheet gives 6.37×10⁶ m.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/轨道运动：引力提供向心力；v = √(G: In a circular orbit gravity supplies exactly the centripetal force: GmM/r²=mv²/r, which gives v=√(GM/r). The orbital speed depends only on the mass of the central body and the orbital radius, not on the mass of the satellite. Here r must be measured from the centre of the Earth, that is Earth’s radius plus orbital altitude, and forgetting to add the radius is the most common reason for lost marks.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/轨道周期与开普勒第三定律 T²/r³ =: Using gravity as the centripetal force to find the period gives Kepler’s third law, T²/r³=4π²/GM, in which the ratio is fixed by the mass of the central body alone. The larger the orbital radius, the longer the period and the smaller the speed. It can be used to compare different central bodies or satellites, for example to deduce the mass of the Earth from the Moon’s period.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/开普勒第一定律（椭圆轨道）与第二定律（面: The first law says that a planet moves in an elliptical orbit with the central body at one focus, so the planet–Sun distance varies periodically. The second law says that the line joining a planet to the Sun sweeps out equal areas in equal times, which is equivalent to the planet moving fastest at perihelion and slowest at aphelion and is fundamentally conservation of angular momentum.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/地球同步卫星（T = 24 h）；通信与: The period must equal the Earth’s rotation period, and T²=4π²r³/GM gives an orbital radius of about 4.2×10⁷ m, that is about 3.6×10⁷ m above the equator. It must stay directly above the equator, otherwise it would drift relative to the ground, and for this reason it cannot cover the polar regions.
PHY 物理/U3 · 重力与卫星运动/质心 barycentre（地月系统，力: For a binary system the barycentre satisfies m₁r₁=m₂r₂; the Earth–Moon barycentre lies about 1700 km below the Earth’s surface and both bodies actually orbit that point. Orbits are classified by altitude as low Earth orbit (LEO), medium Earth orbit (MEO) and geostationary orbit (GEO); a polar orbit gives global coverage and is used for remote sensing and weather observation.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/力矩 τ = rF sinθ（单位 N·m）: Torque τ=rF sinθ measures the turning effect of a force about an axis, and its unit N·m is a derived unit that must not be written as J. The angle θ is between the force and the lever arm, the perpendicular distance from the axis to the line of action of the force. When the line of action passes through the axis the lever arm is zero and the force produces no torque.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/符号约定：逆时针为正、顺时针为负: Before writing the rotational equilibrium equation you must choose a positive direction of rotation, usually anticlockwise positive and clockwise negative, and keep it consistent throughout the question. A negative calculated torque only means the rotation is opposite to the convention; it does not mean the magnitude of the torque is negative. Changing the sign convention part-way through is a common way to lose marks.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/非垂直力的分解；净力矩: When a force is not perpendicular to the rod there are two equivalent approaches: resolve the force into components along and perpendicular to the rod, of which only the perpendicular component produces torque, or find the lever arm of the whole force and multiply by it. The two methods must give the same answer and can be used to check each other. The net torque is the algebraic sum of all the torques, and its being zero is the condition for rotational equilibrium.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/平衡条件：ΣF = 0（平动平衡）+ Στ: A rigid body is in equilibrium only when both conditions hold: the net force is zero so it does not translate, and the net torque is zero so it does not rotate. The pivot may be chosen freely, and a clever choice makes the lever arm of an unknown force zero and so simplifies the equation. A single equation is usually not enough to solve for two unknowns.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/经典题型：跷跷板、梯子靠墙、跳水板、木板与绳: The standard approach for seesaws, ladders against a wall, diving boards, planks with ropes and cantilever beams is to draw a free body diagram, choose as pivot a point through which several unknown forces act, write Στ=0, and add ΣF=0 as needed. In a ladder problem note that the wall exerts only a normal force while the ground exerts both a normal force and friction, and a seesaw problem often requires the position of the centre of mass. Weight acts at the centre of gravity.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/撑杆与拉索 struts and ties: A strut is in compression and a tie is in tension; to decide which, isolate the member and see whether the forces at its two ends push it or pull it. In a truss-like structure, applying ΣF=0 at each joint in turn determines the internal force in every member, and a negative result means the actual force is opposite to the assumed direction.
PHY 物理/U3 · 力矩与平衡/静平衡与质心；稳定性 stability: An object will not topple as long as its line of action of weight falls inside its base of support, which is when a restoring torque is available. Stability improves with a wider base and a lower centre of mass. To find the centre of mass of a composite body, weight each part by its mass rather than taking the geometric midpoint, and treat a hollow section as negative mass.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/电荷与电场；电场线（+向外/−向内、密度=: An electric field surrounds every charge, and field lines run from positive charge to negative charge (or to infinity); the spacing of the lines shows the field strength, and no two field lines can cross. Field lines are a descriptive tool rather than real lines, and they are always perpendicular to the equipotential surfaces.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/库仑定律 F = kq₁q₂/r²；k =: The force between two point charges is F=kq₁q₂/r², where k=1/(4πε₀)=9.00×10⁹ N·m²·C⁻². Substitute the charges with their signs so that attraction and repulsion can be distinguished, and the force acts along the line joining them. Coulomb’s law has the same form as Newton’s law of universal gravitation: both are inverse-square laws.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/三电荷以上：叠加原理（矢量和）: The force exerted on a charge by several other charges is the vector sum of the individual forces, so find each magnitude and direction first and then add components; magnitudes must not simply be added or subtracted. For two equal like charges the net field strength at the midpoint is zero, whereas for two equal opposite charges it is a maximum there, a commonly examined symmetric case.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/电场强度 E = F/q = kQ/r²（: Electric field strength is the electric force per unit positive charge, E=F/q=kQ/r², and its direction is the direction of the force on a positive charge; the unit N/C is equivalent to V/m. E is a property of the field and does not depend on whether a test charge is placed there, and the test charge must be small enough not to disturb the original field.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/电场中的功与能：W = Eqd = qΔV: The work done by an electric field is W=qEd=qΔV, determined only by the potential difference between the start and end points and not by the path, so the electrostatic force is conservative. Combined with the work–energy theorem W=ΔE_k it gives the speed of a particle directly from the accelerating voltage, for example v=√(2qV/m), with no need to consider how the field is distributed in between.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/电势差 ΔV 与重力势能的类比: Potential difference is the change in potential energy per unit charge between two points, ΔV=ΔE_p/q=W/q, measured in volts, and it can be compared with a height difference in a gravitational field. When a positive charge moves along the field lines the potential and the potential energy both decrease; for a negative charge the opposite happens, which is the most common judgement error.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/平行板间匀强电场 E = V/d: Between parallel plates the electric field is approximately uniform with magnitude E=V/d and direction from the positive plate to the negative plate. Note that d is the plate separation and not the plate length, and V is the voltage between the plates. A charged particle between the plates usually requires both the electric force in the vertical direction and the uniform motion in the horizontal direction.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/带电粒子在电场中的偏转（类平抛运动）: A particle entering the region between parallel plates perpendicular to the field undergoes projectile-like motion: uniform velocity along the plates and uniform acceleration perpendicular to them with a=qE/m=qV/(md). The deflection is y=½at² with t=L/v, and the exit speed is found by combining components with Pythagoras, exactly as for projectile motion.
PHY 物理/U3 · 静电力与电场/电子伏特 1 eV = 1.60×10⁻¹: The electron volt is a unit of energy, not of voltage, equal to the energy gained by one electron crossing a potential difference of 1 V, 1 eV=1.60×10⁻¹⁹ J. It is convenient in atomic and nuclear physics, for example the ionisation energy of hydrogen is 13.6 eV or 2.18×10⁻¹⁸ J; when converting, the charge must not be left out.
PHY 物理/U3 · 磁学 Magnetism/磁通密度 B（特斯拉 T）与磁: The quantity describing the strength of a magnetic field is written B, measured in tesla (T), and is often simply called the magnetic field strength. Outside a magnet the field lines run from the N pole to the S pole and inside from S to N; they always form closed loops and never cross, and B is larger where the lines are closer together.
PHY 物理/U3 · 磁学 Magnetism/长直导线磁场 B = μ₀I/: The magnetic field around a long straight current-carrying wire consists of concentric circles with magnitude B=μ₀I/2πr, proportional to the current and inversely proportional to the distance, where μ₀=4π×10⁻⁷ N·A⁻². The direction is found with the right-hand grip rule: the thumb points along the current and the curled fingers give the field direction. Inside a solenoid the field is approximately uniform.

PHY 物理/U4 · 光的粒子性/光电方程 KE_max = hf − W；遏: Conservation of energy in the photoelectric effect is expressed as KE_max=hf−φ: part of the photon energy is used to escape the metal and the remainder becomes the maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectron. The reverse voltage that just reduces the photocurrent to zero is the stopping potential, and eV_s=KE_max, so a graph of V_s against f gives h/e and φ/e.
PHY 物理/U4 · 光的粒子性/波粒二象性 wave–particle du: Light shows wave behaviour while propagating (interference, diffraction, polarisation) and particle behaviour when interacting with matter (the photoelectric effect, Compton scattering), and the two aspects cannot appear in the same experiment at the same time. De Broglie went further and showed that matter particles such as electrons also have wave properties, so wave–particle duality is a property common to all microscopic objects.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/黑体辐射：光谱形状及其随温度的依赖；经典: A black body is an ideal object that absorbs and re-emits all incident electromagnetic radiation, and its spectrum depends only on temperature: as the temperature rises the total radiated intensity increases and the peak wavelength shifts towards shorter wavelengths according to Wien’s displacement law. Classical wave theory predicted that the intensity should tend to infinity at short wavelengths (the ultraviolet catastrophe), which disagrees with the observed curve, and this conflict led Planck to propose energy quantisation.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/德布罗意物质波 λ = h/p = h/: De Broglie proposed that a matter particle also has an associated matter wave of wavelength λ=h/p=h/mv, so the greater the momentum the shorter the wavelength. It began as a theoretical conjecture and was later confirmed by electron diffraction experiments. For a macroscopic object the wavelength is extremely small (of order 10⁻³⁴ m) and completely unobservable, which is why matter waves are not seen in everyday life.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/宏观物体/人/电子三案例对比：宏观波长过: Comparing the three with λ=h/mv shows the difference: a person (about 70 kg at 1 m·s⁻¹) has a wavelength of about 10⁻³⁵ m, far smaller than an atomic nucleus, while an electron at 10⁶ m·s⁻¹ has a wavelength of about 10⁻⁹ m, comparable with atomic spacing, so it can produce observable diffraction from a crystal. The criterion is simply a comparison of orders of magnitude between the wavelength and the size of the obstacle.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/戴维孙-革末实验：电子衍射证实物质波: Davisson and Germer fired a beam of low-energy electrons at a nickel crystal and measured a distribution of scattered intensity with clear maxima whose pattern was exactly like that of X-ray diffraction, and the wavelength deduced from it agreed with λ=h/p. This was the first direct experimental evidence for the matter-wave hypothesis and showed that electrons can be diffracted by a crystal grating just like waves.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/双缝实验重做：电子逐个通过也会累积出干涉: When the double-slit experiment is performed with electrons, even if they are emitted one at a time the screen first shows only scattered bright dots, but after a long accumulation interference fringes still emerge. This shows that a single electron also passes through both slits as a wave and interferes with itself, while the landing point of each individual electron is random, its probability being determined by the intensity of the wave.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/应用：电子显微镜（TEM/SEM/STE: Because the wavelength of electrons can be far shorter than that of visible light, an electron microscope forms its image with an electron beam and can reach atomic resolution (about 10⁻¹⁰ m); TEM shows transmitted internal structure and SEM shows surface morphology. Similarly, neutron diffraction is well suited to locating hydrogen atoms and magnetic structure, while X-ray diffraction is used to determine crystal structures.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/四类光谱：线状发射光谱、带状光谱、连续光: A continuous spectrum is emitted by a hot solid or liquid and contains all wavelengths; a line emission spectrum is emitted by a low-pressure excited gas and contains only a few bright lines; an absorption spectrum consists of dark lines appearing when continuous light passes through a cool gas; and a band spectrum is produced by molecules. The lines of a line spectrum and of an absorption spectrum coincide exactly, which is the key to identifying elements.
PHY 物理/U4 · 黑体辐射与光谱/光谱分析：元素的特征谱线: Every element has a unique set of characteristic spectral lines that acts like a fingerprint for identification. Comparing the spectrum of an unknown sample with standard spectra determines its composition, a principle used both for elemental analysis in the laboratory and for deducing the composition of distant stars from their absorption spectra, and it requires no contact between the sample and the instrument.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/玻尔假设：电子只能在特定轨道上具有固定能量: Bohr assumed that an electron can occupy only certain discrete allowed orbits with quantised energy, so it does not radiate energy continuously as it moves around the nucleus; the lowest level is the ground state and a higher level reached after absorbing energy is an excited state. This assumption overrides the classical electromagnetic conclusion that an accelerating charge must radiate.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/氢原子能级图（−13.60、−3.40、−: The hydrogen energy levels are −13.60, −3.40, −1.51, −0.85, −0.54 eV and so on, becoming closer together at higher levels, with the zero taken as the electron completely removed from the atom. Negative levels mean the electron is bound, and the magnitude is the energy needed to move it to infinity. When drawing transition arrows, remember that upward arrows are absorption and downward arrows emission.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/跃迁规则：吸收或释放的能量必须恰好等于两能: An electron can only make a transition between levels if the energy absorbed or released is exactly equal to the difference between the two levels, ΔE=E₂−E₁, so only photons of matching energy can be absorbed. This is why an absorption spectrum consists of discrete dark lines: a photon whose energy does not match cannot be absorbed and so leaves no mark on the spectrum.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/激发态寿命约 10⁻⁸ s；退激可一步或多: An excited state is very short-lived, and after about 10⁻⁸ s the electron returns spontaneously to a lower level. De-excitation may happen in one step back to the ground state, emitting a high-energy photon, or in several steps through intermediate levels, each step emitting one photon of a particular energy; an element can therefore produce many spectral lines, with several possible transition paths.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/电离 Ionisation：电离能；超过阈: Ionisation is the complete removal of an electron from its level so that it becomes a free electron, and the minimum energy required is the ionisation energy (13.6 eV for hydrogen in the ground state). If more energy than the ionisation energy is supplied, the excess all becomes kinetic energy of the free electron, and the absorption spectrum then changes from discrete lines to a continuum.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/用 ΔE = hf = hc/λ 解释发射: Photon energy is related to the level difference by ΔE=hf=hc/λ. In absorption an electron rises and takes a photon whose energy exactly matches, giving a dark line; in emission an electron falls and releases a photon of the corresponding wavelength, giving a bright line. The emission and absorption lines of the same element therefore coincide exactly in position, being complementary in brightness and darkness.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/氢光谱系列：Lyman（紫外）、Balme: The spectral lines of hydrogen are grouped into series according to the final level of the transition: the Lyman series ends at n=1 and lies in the ultraviolet; the Balmer series ends at n=2 and lies mainly in the visible; the Paschen series ends at n=3 and lies in the infrared. To decide which series a line belongs to, simply see which level it terminates on.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/能级计算 E = −13.6 Z²/n²: The energy levels of a hydrogen-like ion are E=−13.6 Z²/n² (eV), proportional to the square of the nuclear charge number and inversely proportional to the square of the principal quantum number, with the negative sign showing that the electron is bound. To find the wavelength of a transition photon, first calculate the difference between the two levels and then use λ=hc/ΔE. Z applies only to single-electron ions and cannot be used directly for many-electron atoms.
PHY 物理/U4 · 玻尔原子模型/应用：荧光与磷光、X 射线产生、激光、光伏: These applications all rest on level transitions: fluorescence and phosphorescence differ in how long the afterglow of de-excitation lasts, lasers produce coherent monochromatic light by stimulated emission, X-rays are produced when fast electrons strike a metal target or by inner-shell transitions, and LEDs and photovoltaic cells convert between electrical and light energy. In an explanation, state which two levels are involved.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/天文距离单位：AU（1.50×10¹¹ m）、光: Astronomical distances use special units: 1 AU is the mean Earth–Sun distance, 1.50×10¹¹ m; 1 light-year is the distance light travels in a vacuum in a year, about 9.46×10¹² km; and 1 parsec is about 3.26 light-years, that is 3.09×10¹⁶ m. Intergalactic distances are usually given in Mpc, and the conversion factors should be taken from the data sheet.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/稳恒态理论 Steady State（各向同性: The Steady State theory holds that although the universe is expanding it remains isotropic and homogeneous on the largest scales and does not change with time, with the density maintained by the continuous creation of matter, so that it has no beginning. Its key difference from the Big Bang is precisely whether the universe has a starting point, and it was refuted by the discovery of the cosmic microwave background radiation.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/多普勒效应；红移与蓝移（波长变长/变短）: The Doppler effect is the change in observed frequency when there is relative motion between a wave source and an observer. When a source moves away the wavelength is stretched, which is a redshift, and when it approaches the wavelength is shortened, which is a blueshift. Note that “red” and “blue” here mean only that the wavelength has lengthened or shortened; they are not restricted to the visible band and apply to any electromagnetic wave.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/红移参数 z = (λ_观测 − λ_静止)/λ: The redshift parameter is defined as z=(λ_observed−λ_rest)/λ_rest, and when z is much less than 1 the recession speed can be found from z≈v/c. Here λ_rest is the wavelength of the same spectral line measured in the laboratory, and it can only be identified by matching characteristic lines. A negative z means a blueshift, so that object is approaching us.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/哈勃定律 v = H₀d；H₀ = 70.0 k: Hubble’s law states that the recession speed of a galaxy is proportional to its distance, v=H₀d, with H₀≈70.0 km·s⁻¹·Mpc⁻¹. Plotting d on the horizontal axis and v on the vertical axis gives the Hubble constant as the gradient, and its unit must be converted to s⁻¹. Note that d must be in Mpc to match the unit of H₀; substituting metres directly is out by several orders of magnitude.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/距离测量：亮度与光度；造父变星 Cepheid: From the observed brightness b and a known luminosity L the distance can be deduced: b=L/(4πd²). The pulsation period of a Cepheid variable has a definite relationship with its luminosity, so measuring the period gives the luminosity, which is why Cepheids are called standard candles. They are a key link in the cosmic distance ladder and were the basis of Hubble’s original measurements of galaxy distances.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/宇宙膨胀的含义：空间本身在膨胀（星系与地球内部由: Expansion means that space itself is stretching, not that galaxies are flying outwards through a pre-existing space, so there is no centre of expansion and observers in any galaxy would see the same recession pattern. The interiors of galaxies, the solar system and atoms are held together by gravitational or electromagnetic forces, so the space inside them does not expand with the universe.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/宇宙年龄估算 t = 1/H₀ ≈ 137 亿年: If the rate of expansion is assumed constant, the time needed to run the galaxies back to a single point is the reciprocal of the Hubble constant, t=1/H₀, and with H₀=70.0 km·s⁻¹·Mpc⁻¹ this gives about 1.4×10¹⁰ years, that is about 14 billion years. This estimate ignores changes in the rate of expansion, so it is only a lower-limit result correct in order of magnitude.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/大爆炸时间线：暴胀→夸克汤→冷却形成质子中子→核: A very short time after the Big Bang came inflation, followed by a hot quark–gluon plasma; as the temperature fell the quarks combined into protons and neutrons, and within roughly the first few minutes light-element nucleosynthesis produced hydrogen, helium and a little lithium, after which nuclear reactions stopped abruptly. The abundances of the light elements in the universe are therefore a fossil record of primordial nucleosynthesis.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/四大证据：哈勃定律、宇宙微波背景辐射 CMBR（: The four main pieces of evidence for the Big Bang are: Hubble’s law, which shows that the universe is expanding; the cosmic microwave background radiation, the redshifted afterglow of the original hot radiation (about 2.7 K, with peak wavelength about 1.06 mm); light-element abundances that agree with theoretical predictions; and the widespread redshift of galaxy spectra. Hubble’s law and galactic redshift are essentially two aspects of the same piece of evidence.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/宇宙的未来：闭合、平坦、开放三种模型；临界密度约: The future of the universe depends on how the actual mean density compares with the critical density: above the critical density the universe is closed and expansion will eventually turn into contraction (the big crunch); equal to it the universe is flat and expands for ever at a decreasing rate; below it the universe is open and expands for ever. Current observations indicate a nearly flat universe whose expansion is accelerating, which requires dark energy to explain.
PHY 物理/U4 · 宇宙学/宇宙学原理：各向同性 + 均匀性: The cosmological principle assumes that on the largest scales the universe is isotropic (the same in every direction) and homogeneous (matter is distributed identically everywhere), and this is the starting point shared by the Steady State and Big Bang theories alike. It holds only on the largest scales: on the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters the universe is clearly not uniform.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/科学探究技能：提出问题、假设、设计实验、安全操作、收集: The complete chain of scientific inquiry is to pose a question, form a testable hypothesis, design and carry out the experiment, collect valid data under safe conditions, and analyse them to reach a conclusion. A hypothesis must be falsifiable and must relate explicitly to the variables being measured. Every stage needs a written record, because assessment is about the process and not only the result.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/SI 单位与有效数字表达；识别趋势、规律与关系: All data should be recorded in SI units with an appropriate number of significant figures, and final answers are written to 3 significant figures. When identifying a trend, use the data or the graph to state whether the relationship between the variables is proportional, inversely proportional or a square relationship; for instance, “proportional” requires evidence of a straight line through the origin, and writing only “related” earns no marks.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/不确定度的陈述、计算与合成；异常数据识别与 % dif: A measurement must be reported in the form value ± uncertainty unit, with uncertainties combined according to the type of operation. Outliers should be identified using two standard deviations or a clear procedural reason, not simply because a value deviates greatly. Percentage difference is used to compare two measured values while percentage error is used to compare with a theoretical value; the two must not be mixed up.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/用证据得出结论、评价过程、构建科学论证、量纲分析: Conclusions must be traceable to specific data and physical principles, not merely an answer. An evaluation of the procedure should identify the real sources of error and concrete improvements (such as using a more precise instrument or taking more measurements), rather than writing vaguely that “error came from human factors”. Dimensional analysis can be used both to check whether a formula has been rearranged correctly and to work out the unit a gradient should have.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/抛体运动实验（测水平初速度并与能量守恒对比）；单摆测重: In the projectile experiment the initial speed is calculated from the measured horizontal range and drop height and then compared with the value predicted by conservation of energy to test the model. In the pendulum experiment the period equation T=2π√(l/g) is rearranged to T²=4π²l/g and g is found from the gradient of a graph of T² against l. The amplitude must be kept below about 10° for the simple harmonic approximation to hold, and many complete oscillations should be timed to reduce timing error.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/锥形摆测向心力；力桌实验验证矢量合成: In the conical pendulum the radius and angular velocity are varied, and a graph of F against ω² should be a straight line through the origin with gradient equal to mr. In the force table experiment three strings pull on a ring at different angles until it is in equilibrium, testing that the resultant of any two of the forces is equal in magnitude and opposite in direction to the third, and so verifying the parallelogram law of vector addition. Both use a graphical method to reduce random error.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/磁学实验：条形磁铁力-距离关系、载流导体受力、长直导线: Magnetism experiments are usually of three kinds: measuring the force between bar magnets as a function of distance with a balance or force sensor to test an inverse-square or power law (which requires taking logarithms to linearise first); passing a current through a conductor in a magnetic field to verify F=BIl; and using a Hall probe to measure the field around a long straight wire and test how B varies with 1/r. In each case the background effect of the Earth’s magnetic field must be eliminated first.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/光学实验：折射性质探究、衍射法测激光波长、可见光谱与原: Optics experiments generally include measuring the angle of refraction in a semicircular glass block for various angles of incidence to verify Snell’s law and find the refractive index; measuring the wavelength of a laser with a diffraction grating using nλ=d sinθ; and observing the line emission spectra of elements with spectral tubes and a grating. For the last of these, the spectrometer must be calibrated first and several lines read and averaged to reduce random error.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/普朗克常数测定；电阻串并联: The classic method of measuring Planck’s constant is to measure the stopping potential for several filters of different wavelength, plot V_s against f, take h/e from the gradient and multiply by e to obtain h. In the resistance experiment the currents and voltages of series and parallel combinations are measured to verify R_series=R₁+R₂ and 1/R_parallel=1/R₁+1/R₂, bearing in mind the systematic error introduced by the internal resistance of the meters.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/演示实验：电动机与交流发电机、光电效应模拟、范德格拉夫: Demonstrations turn an abstract model into something visible: a motor and a generator are reverses of each other, a photoelectric effect simulation shows the separate effects of intensity and frequency, a Van de Graaff generator demonstrates charge accumulation and discharge, and demonstrations of the Bohr model and of relativity build an intuitive picture. When watching, focus on how what you see corresponds to the equations in the textbook.
PHY 物理/实验与实践/实验报告范例：胡克定律测弹簧劲度系数（静态 F−x 与: The Hooke’s law experiment can determine the spring constant in two ways: the static method plots F against extension x, with gradient k, while the dynamic method plots T² against mass m, which from T=2π√(m/k) has gradient 4π²/k. Similar results from the two methods confirm each other. In the density experiment the uncertainties in mass and volume are combined separately, then the percentage uncertainty in density is found using the rule for multiplication and division.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/校本任务：TT1（14%）、EA 评估与分析（12: Physics assessment totals 100%: Tests 40% (TT1 14%, TT2 14%, EA 12%), Examination 50% (EE 20%, FE 30%) and Science Inquiry 10%. EA is the evaluation and analysis task and EE is the evaluation examination; the names are similar but the nature of the two is different, so be sure to distinguish them before filling in any form.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/TT1 范围：重力、水平/竖直圆周运动、静平衡与质: TT1 covers gravity and satellite motion, horizontal and vertical circular motion, and static equilibrium and centre of mass; the EE additionally covers relativity and electromagnetism, so its scope is clearly wider. When revising, work through the recurring common topics such as centre of mass and equilibrium first, since they are examined in both TT1 and the EE.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/TT2 范围：电磁学、波粒二象性与量子理论；FE: TT2 covers electromagnetism and wave–particle duality and quantum theory, while the FE (final examination) covers all of Unit 3 and Unit 4, carries a weighting of 30% and is the single most heavily weighted assessment. Preparation for the FE must therefore be a full-scope review built around the formula and data sheet, not a bet on the topics that have already been examined.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/WACE 外部考试（180 分 / 3 小时）：S: The WACE external written examination lasts 3 hours and is marked out of 180, made up of short answer (30%), extended answer (50%), and comprehension and data analysis (20%), with the extended answer worth the most. Answers must show the full formula, the substitution and the units; a final answer on its own earns nothing. Section 3 usually presents an unfamiliar context and tests the ability to transfer models from the course to a new situation.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/考试规则：最终答案 3 位有效数字、估算最多 2: The examination requirements are firm: all numerical answers to 3 significant figures (estimates to at most 2), units always included, and the complete working shown. Use the constants from the official formula and data sheet and set out the derivation clearly in the left-hand column. These are the easiest process marks both to secure and to lose.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/VAULT OF ATPHY（79 页）：课程总览: This 79-page overview document brings together the course outline, assessment outline, science inquiry skills, formula and data sheet, laboratory manual and sample reports. The two most worth revisiting before an examination are the formula and data sheet, which decides whether the calculation questions are right, and the sample reports, which decide whether the experimental questions earn full marks.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/各 Topic 讲义：向量、力与斜面、功与能、动量: Covering in course order everything from vectors and inclines to cosmology, these are the primary revision material. The electromagnetism and quantum theory notes are the most numerous and correspond to the emphasis in TT2 and the FE; it is best to read them through in numbered order and then use the end-of-topic questions to check whether the material has really been mastered.
PHY 物理/考核与配套资源/REVISION 复习卷：TT1 / EA / F: The REVISION papers are organised by assessment type, TT1, EA and FE, and come with past WACE papers and full solutions. The most effective approach is to attempt them first under timed, independent conditions and then go through them against the marking key, focusing on whether the marks lost were for process or for the conclusion. The papers of the last five years are closest to the real examination in coverage and style.
